modos.descricao: Dono ganha 4 VP. Todos personagens Gaia ganham +2 Health permanente.

_metadata.texto_original: This Rite takes the form of a moot, as caern building requires cooperation. Select a player to own the caern. If the vote passes, the player gains 4 victory points. For the remainder of the game, all Gaia characters in play get +2 Health.
